run_dense_eval_hybrid: run the AdsorbML dense evaluation script with a results file to compute hybrid ML+DFT success rates
run_dense_eval_ml_only: run the AdsorbML dense evaluation script with the ml-success flag to compute ML-only success rates
compute_hybrid_success: compute AdsorbML hybrid success rates at varying top-k values comparing ML+DFT energies to ground truth DFT
compute_valid_ml_success: compute validated ML-only success rates by checking if ML energies are within 0.1 eV of DFT energies
filter_ml_data: filter ML data by setting missing systems or configurations to high energy values for failure case evaluation
